content.comment_body: To the developers of the [product_name] app (which is great): Please consider adding a feature to download datalogs directly from [product_name]. This would be a valuable addition.
I believe this can be done using [product_name] software: go to Tools, then Transfer, and choose Upload data log. Please refer to the attached document.
While it is indeed possible through [product_name] software on PC, my suggestion was specifically about implementing this feature in the [product_name] smartphone app. Sorry for any confusion.

analysis.insight_summary: A user appreciates the current [product_name] app but points out the absence of a datalog download function within the mobile app. They note that the PC version offers this capability, suggesting room for improvement in mobile functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants the ability to download datalogs from [product_name] devices directly via the smartphone app, aiming for improved convenience and mobility.
